name: Gnome Engineering
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin.  While I think it is a waste, you should be aware of gnome specialization.  They make items and gadgets that claim to change the world, but rarely work.

adventurer, read this manual.  If you wish to learn how to make metal paper weights, then take the manual to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.   Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task.
narrative.objectives: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've come to learn about gnome engineering, eh? Well, you've come to the right gnome. While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.

They and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello there! If you've come about a homing robot that may have smashed through a wall of your domicile, then I will refer you to my barrister in advance. Otherwise, what can I do for you today?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 47, 3,990 XP in all.

quests.name: Gnome Engineering
quests.objectiveText: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
quests.objectiveText: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.

quests.name: Show Your Work
quests.objectiveText: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
